AUTHORITY.label: Authority
AUTHORITY.hint: Claims to be police, CBI, RBI, SEBI, Microsoft, HR

PERSONALISATION.label: Personalisation
PERSONALISATION.hint: Uses a fact from the victim's world

FEAR.label: Fear
FEAR.hint: Arrest, jail, account freeze, job loss, contacts told

ISOLATION.label: Isolation
ISOLATION.hint: Don't tell anyone, stay on the line, SEBI rules

CONTROL.label: Control
CONTROL.hint: Screen share, remote access, don't hang up

PAYMENT_STEERING.label: Payment steering
PAYMENT_STEERING.hint: OTP, UPI, deposit, tax before withdrawal

RECIPROCITY.label: Reciprocity
RECIPROCITY.hint: Fake refund, overpayment, we already helped you

long_call.label: Call with a non-contact passed 3 min

otp_arrived.label: OTP arrived while a session is live

bank_opened.label: Bank or UPI app opened mid-session

group_isolation.label: Group joined via link and told not to discuss outside

otp_read.label: OTP read out to the caller

payment_tapped.label: Pay button tapped for the caller

engagement.note: Caller pressure is scaled by how far the victim has gone along: cold = nothing yet, warm = one compliance or a soft device signal, hot = two compliances or a hard device signal.
